sources: MDC GIS Area_Feature_Layers/FeatureServer/27 'Camping Sites' (1 point) and /26 'Parking Lots' (1 lot), queried 2026-11-09
Esri World Imagery (summer) 400 m frame around 39.6218,-92.5105, viewed 2026-11-09
note: Small area of bottomland fields, beaver ponds, oxbow sloughs and managed wetland pools on the East Fork Little Chariton River, with forested coal-spoil ridges on the east half; the river is walk-in only. The one designated camping spot is a mowed opening behind the gravel lot on Jackpot Street. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites', one mapped camping spot beside the area's only gravel lot on Jackpot Street, free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. Pin is at the spot (just inside the tree line of a mowed opening). Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Designated Camping Sites'; the 1/6/2026 map puts its only Parking + Camping site symbols together at the north edge on Jackpot Street, and GIS has one 'Primitive Camping Area' point (39.62187,-92.51053) 64 m SW of the lot (39.6223,-92.51003, Gravel, Allows_Trailers 'No'). Imagery: a ~25 x 20 m gravel pull-off on the gravel county road with a mowed grass opening (~80 x 40 m) behind it - drive-in for a 23-ft rig, no ford.

PIN: the stored pin (the GIS point) sits ~7 m inside the tree line at the back of the mowed opening; moving it ~30 m north onto the opening (about 39.6221,-92.5104) would put it on open ground - optional.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront): confirmed. The East Fork Little Chariton runs along the west boundary ~400 m away (walk-in); the wetland pools lie south in the bottoms; a muddy slough/ditch north of Jackpot Street is ~50 m off across the road and outside the area.
Note rewritten: generic MDC text, the site-length line and the directions dropped.

fees.source: https://mdc.mo.gov/discover-nature/activities/camping ('All camping on conservation areas is free'); the area page (https://mdc.mo.gov/discover-nature/places/bee-hollow-conservation-area) lists no fee, read 2026-11-09

hookups.source: https://mdc.mo.gov/discover-nature/activities/camping ('no RV hookups are provided at any department area'), read 2026-11-09

booking.source: https://mdc.mo.gov/discover-nature/places/bee-hollow-conservation-area (area regulations 3CSR 10-11 140: 'camping is limited to a period of 14 consecutive days in any 30-day period'; no reservation for individual camping) + https://mdc.mo.gov/discover-nature/activities/camping ('most camping is first come, first served'), read 2026-11-09
